name: Enomoto Kaho
source:
Kaho was a side character in Your Diary's normal versions, but in Your Diary + and Your Diary + H, it's finally her time to shine. Kaho is energetic, very good at sports, an idiot at school and has a lot of lesbian fans. She is also Yuuhi's best friend and always there to support her along with Hibiki.

[Taken from [url=http://www.craneanime.com/2014/02/information-your-diaryh.html?showComment=1401799750650#c2584639592849262674]CraneAnime[/url]]
